newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia awards hospital pacts to three firms.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia awards hospital pacts to three firms.

text.p: Malaysia has awarded a 7.5 billion ringgit concession to three companies to provide nationwide hospital support services for 15 years.

The firms -- Faber Group Bhd's Faber Medi-Serve Sdn Bhd unit, Radicare (M) Sdn Bhd and Tongkah Holdings Bhd's Tongkah Medivest Sdn Bhd unit -- will manage five support services at the hospitals and four medical institutions, the national Bernama news agency said.
The privatisation project will cost 500 million ringgit a year over 15 years effective from January 1, 1997, the agency said in a report late on Monday.
Faber Medi-Serve Sdn Bhd will take over the services in northern Malaysia covering four states, as well as the East Malaysia states of Sabah and Sarawak and the Labuan offshore financial centre.
Radicare, which is a joint venture company between Asia Lab (M) Sdn Bhd and Realmild (M) Sdn Bhd, will focus on four states and the federal territory.

Tongkah Medivest will take over support services in hospitals in the southern states of Melaka, Negeri Sembilan and Johor. The stock of its parent, Tongkah Holdings, was suspended on Monday for a news annoucement.
The services to be privatised are clinical waste management, cleaning services, linen and laundry services, engineering maintenance services and bio-medical engineering services, Bernama reported.
